'''Deagan Farrell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who worked on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] with fellow bounty hunter trainer, [[Bulga]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Deagan Farrell awards players of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]] class their class rewards at the end of the three main chapters of the class storyline in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Farrell's last name is only mentioned in the game's mission logs and not on the character's in-game name plaque.
